message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to place an Uber ride for you. However, I can walk you through how to do it on your phone:

1. Open the Uber app (or download it from the App Store/Google Play if you haven’t already).
2. In the “Where to?” field, enter your pickup location (e.g., “Berkeley, CA” or your exact address). If you’re already in Berkeley, you can just tap “Confirm Pickup Location” after the app shows your current GPS position.
3. In the “Destination” field, enter your destination or leave it blank if you just want to get a ride to the nearest driver.
4. Tap the “Ride Options” button (usually a small gear icon or the “+” next to the ride type).
5. Scroll through the list of available vehicles and select “Uber Plus.” If it’s not immediately visible, swipe left/right or tap “See all options.”
6. Once you’ve selected Uber Plus, tap “Confirm Uber Plus” (or “Request Uber Plus”).
7. The app will show you the estimated arrival time of the driver. If you want the ride to start in exactly 10 minutes, you can either:
   - Wait until the driver arrives and then tap “Start Ride” when you’re ready, or
   - Use the “Schedule a Ride” feature (tap the clock icon, set the date/time to 10 minutes from now, and confirm).

If you’d like, I can also help you find a nearby driver’s ETA or give you tips on how to ensure you get a Plus vehicle quickly. Just let me know what you’d prefer!
